title: Preliminary pre-publication homepage inspection
content:
# Preliminary inspection report — filing requested

**Overall scoped verdict: pass, based in part on the supplied inspector’s browser report.** The exact staged file and single-file scope meet the pre-publication inspection condition **once this report is recorded**. Pages may then proceed within the recorded authorization, subject to the stop conditions below. Publication and live verification remain outstanding.

- **Root:** `/home/webe/workspace/copilot-worktrees/webe-opolis/justin-leis-urban-giggle`
- **Case:** `WO-2a6bafff-7f89-47e2-b497-d5dc4519dd84`
- **Permit:** `PMT-534ae846-e86c-4747-9fc0-12a8279c9b3c`
- **Revision:** staged `docs/index.html`, SHA-256 `089760a5ff6e7276537547d2996a7bb39ceaf670bb79f3c9a0c9575b1d5b0b9b`; working file has the same digest. Base commit `d2cc55a3b872142daff8f6f41f746019bdbb7022`.
- **Review:** pre-notice, pre-publication inspection—not final lifecycle inspection or acceptance.

## Criteria and evidence

| Check | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Authorization and plan | **Pass, recorded authority only** | `DEC-175b4fab-11dc-4971-bfec-466e9b1cd000` links this order and permit, authorizing one static file and `main:/docs` Pages setup. Order history records confirmation of plan `ART-4668a228-8b67-4470-b1eb-c93b9fced805` before work. The plan’s earlier pending language is historical. Decisions and attribution are unauthenticated. |
| Preparation | **Pass** | Formal screening 2, Advisor application 6 and independent Planner assessment 6 are recorded; assessment outcome is `ready`. This is not a substitute for delivery inspection. |
| Scope | **Pass** | The staged diff adds only `docs/index.html`; locally registered `city-homepage` maps to `docs`. No additional staged path or unstaged change to the page was found. Other local `.city` changes are outside staged delivery and remain preserved. |
| Static page and content | **Pass** | `docs/index.html:1–8, 275–285` contains a static entry page, management statement and the two specified URL attributes. No scripts, external assets, forms or build dependency appear in the file. Host setup and destination reachability are not established. |
| Appearance and responsive presentation | **Pass for inspected views** | I inspected all four supplied screenshots. The narrow and wide views show a legible night-sky, moon and tower design, without an Emerald City aesthetic; the narrow view shows the complete page. Other viewport sizes were not tested. |
| Focus and keyboard | **Pass, relying partly on attributed test** | The two narrow screenshots visibly show focus on each respective link; CSS defines the focus outline at `docs/index.html:171–174`. The supplied inspector report says Tab/Shift-Tab moved first → second → first and Enter produced trusted clicks for the correct URLs with navigation prevented. I did **not** repeat those actions or independently observe the event log. |
| Contrast | **Pass for the reported samples, not exhaustive** | The supplied inspector reports focus contrast of 14.30–14.41:1 and representative text/background samples of 6.47–17.05:1. The screenshots appear readable to me; I did not independently reproduce the numerical measurements or check every gradient position. |
| Assignment | **Pass, unauthenticated attribution** | `ASN-563845e8-292d-4132-9b02-b6e2a19e67b6` assigns the bundled general engineer; the reported author says they worked under that assignment. The bundled engineer is represented as active by the installed workforce implementation. No specialist toolkit is assigned. |
| Pages setup and live checks | **Blocked/outstanding** | No setup result, actual public address, live reachability, rendered live content or destination-resolution result was inspected. These are later requirements, not passed or inapplicable. |

The browser sessions `1863`, `1866` and `1868` returned exit 0 when queried, but no original event output was available to me. The keyboard and numerical contrast conclusions above therefore retain the stated reliance on the supplied report. Screenshot paths are `/tmp/city-browser-evidence-dTYQSy/{narrow-focus-first.png,narrow-focus-second.png,narrow-full.png,wide-focused.png}`; their association with the file digest is also reported rather than independently reconstructed.

## Checks and limitations

- `git diff --cached --check`: **exit 0**.
- `git diff --cached --name-status`: **exit 0**, only `A docs/index.html`.
- `git show :docs/index.html | sha256sum` and `sha256sum docs/index.html`: **exit 0**, matching digest above.
- Source, decision, permit, plan, assignment, policy and preparation records were read directly. Relevant adopted policy and charter digests matched `.city/config.json`.
- An attempted screenshot pixel-sampling command using Python Pillow returned **exit 1**: Pillow is unavailable. No dependency was installed.
- No browser interaction, site build, deployment, Pages settings change, network link check, live check or lifecycle transition was performed. No site-specific test harness was found. CLI status was not run because its permit-lapse processing may write state.
- No adopted zoning map was found. No completion notice exists; it is required later before lifecycle inspection.
- The project registration and case records are local and uncommitted. Their lack of portable custody is a records risk, not a reason to add them to the bounded site delivery. The original work order was not modified.

## Pages gate and filing

**Not yet eligible to act:** the permit requires the inspection result to be **recorded before** Pages enablement or publication. After authorized recording, the inspected digest must remain unchanged; reinspection is needed if it changes. Stop for a separate resident decision if setup requires a paid service, an outside-`docs` file, another target, or additional security or permission changes. Applicable privacy and hosting obligations remain unresolved.

**Filing request to City Manager / Records Officer:** preserve this complete report unchanged as `kind: inspection-report`, `format: markdown`, `sourceOffice: building-inspector`, `workOrderId: WO-2a6bafff-7f89-47e2-b497-d5dc4519dd84`, `recordCategory: filed-work-product`, `supersedes: null`. Persistence is **pending**; no artifact ID or path has been created.

**Inspection verdict not yet recorded — acceptance remains the resident’s decision.**
